votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of January 21, 2025, March 18, 2025, and March 25, 2025.
votes.description: The Board approved the official minutes from three prior CRA meetings held in January and March 2025.

votes.motion: Adopt the consent agenda (setting date of Tuesday, June 10, 2025 at 1 p.m. to accept public comment and consider adopting a resolution amending the CRA budget for FY 2024-25).
votes.description: The Board set a future public hearing date of June 10, 2025 to consider CRA Budget Amendment No. 2 for Fiscal Year 2024-25, which addresses property tax increment obligations, interlocal agreements, reimbursement agreements, interest revenue, and an accounting error.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the CRA Board and reconvene as the City Council.
votes.description: A procedural motion to transition the meeting from the CRA Board to the City Council, made after the consent agenda item was revisited during the Work Session.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, or lease of real property and for attorney-client matters privileged pursuant to Utah Code § 78B-1-137.
votes.description: The Board voted to convene a closed session primarily to discuss real property acquisition strategy and privileged attorney-client matters.

votes.motion: Exit Closed Session and enter back into CRA meeting.
votes.description: The Board voted to conclude the closed session and return to the open CRA meeting.

votes.motion: Close the CRA meeting and reconvene as the City Council in Work Session.
votes.description: A procedural motion to formally adjourn the CRA Board meeting and transition to the City Council Work Session.
